blocks.body:
name = "acme/judges-values"
version = "1.0.0"
[verifier.judges]
samples = 0
min_samples = "x"
lazy = "no"
aggregate = "avg"
llm = 5
vlm = ""
panel = ["a", "b"]
unverified = true

[verifier.judges.agent]
model = ""
effort = 3
aggregate = "medain"
per = "task"
timeout = 600
harness = "judge-loop"
resources = { cpu = 2, memory = "lots" }
services = "yes"
views = ["/logs/agent/t.json", 5, { path = "rel", format = "atif" }, { pth = "/x", format = "trajectory-1" }, { path = "/y" }]
budget = { tokens = 0, tool_calls = -1 }

diagnostics.message: [verifier.judges] aggregate must be one of 'median', 'mean', 'majority', 'min'

[verifier.judges] unverified is gone: a verdict with no verified citation is always flagged no-verified-citation, and at delivery grade the runtime judges that sample once more (docs/judges.md). Remove the key
[verifier.judges] samples is a whole number, at least 1
[verifier.judges] min_samples is a whole number, at least 1
[verifier.judges] lazy is true (the default) or false
[verifier.judges] llm is a model name, or a table [verifier.judges.llm]
[verifier.judges] vlm is a model name, or a table [verifier.judges.vlm]
[verifier.judges.agent] model names a model
[verifier.judges.agent] effort is the model's reasoning effort, such as "high"
[verifier.judges.agent] aggregate must be one of 'median', 'mean', 'majority', 'min'
[verifier.judges.agent] per is "rubric" (one session grades all of the role's criteria) or "criterion" (one session each)
[verifier.judges.agent] timeout must be a duration such as "90s", "15m", or "1h30m"
[verifier.judges.agent] budget tokens is a count: a whole number, or a string of a number and K (1,000) or M (1,000,000) that comes to a whole number, such as 400000, "400K", or "2M"
[verifier.judges.agent] budget tool_calls is a whole number, at least 1
[verifier.judges.agent] harness names a harness and its version, such as "judge-loop@1": conformance is per harness version
unknown key 'cpu' in [verifier.judges.agent] resources; did you mean cpus? it holds cpus, disk, gpu_types, gpus, memory, tpu
[verifier.judges.agent] resources memory must be a size such as "512 MB" or "4 GB"
[verifier.judges.agent] services is true (the task's services run for the judge too) or false

[verifier.judges.agent] views[0] is a bare path, '/logs/agent/t.json', which meant format "atif": ATIF views are cut, since no page defines their bytes. Write { path = "/logs/agent/t.json", format = "trajectory-1" }
[verifier.judges.agent] views[1] is a table { path, format = "trajectory-1" }
[verifier.judges.agent] views[2] needs a path: the absolute path the judge reads it at, such as "/logs/agent/trajectory.json"
[verifier.judges.agent] views[2] format "atif" is cut, since no page defines an ATIF view's bytes: write format = "trajectory-1", the solver's trajectory in the runtime's own record
unknown key 'pth' in [verifier.judges.agent] views[3]; did you mean path? a view holds path and format
[verifier.judges.agent] views[3] needs a path: the absolute path the judge reads it at, such as "/logs/agent/trajectory.json"
[verifier.judges.agent] views[4] format is "trajectory-1", the solver's trajectory in the runtime's own record
the agent judge has no token budget ([verifier.judges.agent] budget = { tokens = ... }): here it is bounded by its timeout, 600, but purpose = "rl" and delivery grade require one
